create_get_cfg: create a default SlowFast config node by calling get_cfg() and returning a cloned CfgNode instance
build_config_validate: build and validate a SlowFast config by calling assert_and_infer_cfg to check batch size, resnet groups, and shard settings
test_config_defaults: test the default SlowFast config values for contrastive learning, batch norm, training, and solver settings
review_assert_and_infer_cfg: review the assert_and_infer_cfg function that validates BN stats, checkpoint types, resnet dimensions, and LR scaling
summarize_get_cfg: summarize the get_cfg function that returns a deep copy of the default SlowFast configuration CfgNode
